answer.main_body: wooden tavern chair with spindle back
answer.evidence: The chair back stands upright at the north (rows 0-7), while the horizontal seat surface is visible from above spanning rows 8-11 (4 rows) before dropping down to the front apron and legs (rows 12-15).
The spindle backrest sits to the north (rows 0-7) and the horizontal seat surface is visible from above across rows 9-11 (approx 3 rows tall) before dropping down to the front edge and legs.
The chair seat is foreshortened and visible from above across rows 9-11 (3 rows deep), with the front edge on row 12 and the spindle backrest rising behind it to the north.

The chair faces south with its backrest to the north (rows 0-7). The horizontal seat surface is visible from above across rows 9-11 (3 pixel rows deep) before dropping to the front edge/apron on row 12 and the legs below.
